items: Solutions / Business Need / Work On... nav bar (rc1c1)
sections.note: global site header nav, excluded from page content

proposed_rules.trigger: A keyword-search input plus filter control and Search/Reset buttons sits directly above a large paged listing grid (expert/partner directory).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as its own 'filter/search' block, separate from and placed above the listing-cards block within the same section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) folding filter controls into the listing block's header row — rejected because filters are a reusable form component, not per-row content; (b) treating search+grid as one combined block — rejected because it would force filter markup into every content row.

provenance.evidence: C142 rc1c2c2c1c2c1c1c2 'Search Reset', preceding rc1c2c2c1c2c2 66-card grid

proposed_rules.trigger: A node positioned at a large negative x-coordinate (off-screen) duplicating text/heading already visible elsewhere on the page, typical of a hidden mobile drawer/menu twin.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from content inventory as noise; it is a hidden UI-state duplicate, not additional content.
proposed_rules.rationale: The tree walker captures elements outside the viewport that are only reachable via a hidden drawer state, not real page content.

provenance.evidence: C142 rc3 @-1280,0 500x720 'Expert Directory' duplicating rc1c2c1c1 heading

proposed_rules.trigger: Pair of [2x1] nodes at bottom of main content: tagline + pipe-separated link list.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global site footer fragment; exclude from page block inventory.

notes: Directory listing page: search/filter block above a 66-card expert grid; an off-canvas duplicate heading suggests a hidden mobile menu twin.
